question: For male legislators from Louisiana, how many distinct legislators were actively serving on December 31 of each year from more than 30 years since their first term up to less than 50 years, grouping the results by the exact number of years elapsed since their first term?
sql:
WITH male_la_legislators AS (
    SELECT l.id_bioguide, MIN(CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE)) as first_term_start
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND lt.state = 'LA'
    GROUP BY l.id_bioguide
),
legislators_with_terms AS (
    SELECT l.id_bioguide, CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) as term_start, CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) as term_end
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND lt.state = 'LA'
),
year_ranges AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, first_term_start,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_term_start)::INTEGER + 31 as min_year,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_term_start)::INTEGER + 49 as max_year
    FROM male_la_legislators
),
all_years AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, first_term_start, year
    FROM year_ranges,
        UNNEST(generate_series(min_year, max_year)) AS t(year)
),
serving_years AS (
    SELECT ay.id_bioguide, ay.first_term_start, ay.year,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ay.year || '-12-31' AS DATE)) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ay.first_term_start) as years_elapsed
    FROM all_years ay
    JOIN legislators_with_terms lwt ON ay.id_bioguide = lwt.id_bioguide
    WHERE CAST(ay.year || '-12-31' AS DATE) >= lwt.term_start
      AND CAST(ay.year || '-12-31' AS DATE) <= lwt.term_end
)
SELECT years_elapsed, COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) as distinct_legislators
FROM serving_years
GROUP BY years_elapsed
ORDER BY years_elapsed
